name.description: The name of the resource (Max 25 characters).
name.rationale: Resource naming follows organizational conventions for identification and management
name.compliant: Uses descriptive names following naming conventions (e.g., 'prod-vpc-connector', 'staging-connector')
name.non-compliant: Generic or unclear names that don't indicate purpose or environment

network.description: Name or self_link of the VPC network. Required if `ip_cidr_range` is set.
network.rationale: Determines which VPC network the connector will bridge to, affecting network segmentation and access controls
network.compliant: Uses dedicated VPC networks with proper segmentation (not 'default' network)
network.non-compliant: Uses 'default' network or shared VPC without proper isolation

ip_cidr_range.description: The range of internal addresses that follows RFC 4632 notation. Example: `10.132.0.0/28`.
ip_cidr_range.rationale: Must use RFC 1918 private IP ranges to prevent exposure to public internet and ensure proper network isolation
ip_cidr_range.non-compliant: Uses public IP ranges or non-RFC 1918 addresses like 200.8.0.0/28

machine_type.description: Machine type of VM Instance underlying connector. Default is e2-micro
machine_type.rationale: Affects performance and cost but not direct security posture
machine_type.compliant: Uses appropriate machine type for workload (e2-micro for light traffic, larger for production)
machine_type.non-compliant: Over-provisioned instances wasting resources or under-provisioned causing performance issues

min_throughput.description: Minimum throughput of the connector in Mbps. Default and min is 200. Value must be a multiple of 100 from 200 through 900.
min_throughput.rationale: Affects availability and performance but not direct security. Deprecated in favor of min_instances
min_throughput.compliant: Set appropriately for expected traffic load with min_throughput < max_throughput

min_instances.description: Minimum value of instances in autoscaling group. Value must be between 2 and 9, inclusive.
min_instances.rationale: Ensures high availability and resilience against instance failures
min_instances.compliant: Set to at least 2 for production workloads to ensure redundancy

max_instances.description: Maximum value of instances in autoscaling group. Value must be between 3 and 10, inclusive.
max_instances.rationale: Prevents resource exhaustion attacks and controls scaling limits
max_instances.compliant: Set reasonable upper bounds (3-10) based on expected load with max > min
max_instances.non-compliant: Unlimited or excessive scaling that could lead to cost overruns

max_throughput.description: Maximum throughput of the connector in Mbps. Default is 300. Value must be a multiple of 100 from 300 through 1000.
max_throughput.rationale: Limits maximum bandwidth to prevent network saturation. Deprecated in favor of max_instances
max_throughput.compliant: Set appropriately above min_throughput with reasonable headroom
max_throughput.non-compliant: Set equal to or below min_throughput

subnet.description: The subnet in which to house the connector. Structure is documented below.
subnet.rationale: Determines specific subnet placement affecting network isolation and firewall rules
subnet.compliant: Uses dedicated subnets with appropriate firewall rules
subnet.non-compliant: Placed in public subnets or subnets with overly permissive access

name.rationale: Identifies specific subnet for connector placement
name.compliant: References private, dedicated subnets for serverless workloads

project_id.description: Project in which the subnet exists. If not set, this project is assumed.
project_id.rationale: Cross-project subnet usage should be carefully controlled
project_id.compliant: Uses subnets within the same project or authorized shared VPC

region.description: Region where the VPC Access connector resides. If not provided, the provider region is used.
region.rationale: Affects data residency, latency, and compliance requirements
region.compliant: Deployed in regions that meet data residency and compliance requirements
region.non-compliant: Deployed in regions that violate data sovereignty requirements

project.description: The project ID. If not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Determines project-level IAM boundaries and resource isolation
project.compliant: Uses appropriate project following least-privilege principles
